status: Examiner's spec for engine/render and engine/providers/render, for Codex's review. Where it assumes an interface the contract does not yet define, README.md says so.

artefacts.returns: application/json {line_art, depth, material_map: base64 PNG; legend: {material_id: "#RRGGBB"}}

still.returns: application/json RenderJobStatus (contracts/providers/render.ts), after the job settles

preview_video.returns: application/json RenderJobStatus (contracts/providers/render.ts), after the job settles

fixture_provider.meaning: The engine's provider abstraction selects a test provider. For stills it returns, per attempt, the next file in the comma-separated list DRAWLOGIC_FIXTURE_RENDER (the last file repeats). For preview video it replays the comma-separated outcomes in DRAWLOGIC_FIXTURE_VIDEO_OUTCOMES (ok | moderation_failed), one per attempt, each attempt on a different catalogue model. Everything after the provider — fidelity scoring, retries, labels, material basis, metering — is the production path.

svg.hatch: an element inside the object group whose fill is url(#id), where #id is a <pattern> in <defs>
svg.line_weights: stroke-width of each layer's geometry is proportional to conventions.line_weights_mm[layer name]; dimensions use line_weights_mm["A-Dims"]
svg.units_note: Only ratios of stroke widths are tested, so any scale or unit choice passes.

dxf.xdata: 1000-group strings "object_id:<id>", "dimension_id:<id>" or "annotation_id:<id>", plus "source:<source>" and "verify:<true|false>" on objects
dxf.layers: one DXF layer per DDL layer, named with the layer's name
dxf.hatch: a HATCH entity carrying the object's xdata for every object whose material category is hatched
dxf.dimensions: a DIMENSION entity per displayed DDL dimension whose measurement equals the value
